messages.content: Hello! I'm your advanced AI companion. How can I assist you with your project or answer any questions today?
I need help redesigning a mobile chat interface with a modern glassmorphic look. I want it to feel premium and very clean.

That sounds like a great project! For a premium glassmorphic look, we should focus on:

• Subtle `backdrop-filter: blur()`
• Thin, translucent borders (1px)
• High contrast typography (Inter is perfect)
• A carefully chosen primary accent color

Shall we start by defining the color palette?
